title: Dialogos project
description: A Dialogos project (file format version 1): who talks, what they say, what the player can answer, when each talk can happen and what it changes. See docs/FORMAT.md. Fields that would say nothing (empty text, empty lists, false) are left out of files, so a missing field means its default. Games may add fields of their own anywhere except inside conditions and effects.

version.title: Format version
version.description: The version of the file format. This schema is for version 1.

lang.title: Language
lang.description: The language the talks are written in ("en", "es"...).

stats.title: Stats
stats.description: The numbers the talks move: trust, romance, money...

places.title: Places
places.description: Where talks can happen and where the player can be.

items.title: Items
items.description: Things the player can have, give or show.

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: On/off marks the game sets itself, or that start on. Flags that only the talks turn on and off need not be listed.

characters.title: Characters
characters.description: Who talks. The player is the character with the id "player".

dialogues.title: Dialogues
dialogues.description: The talks. For each character, a game should prefer the first one that can start.

id.description: An id: what the file uses to point at things (names are only shown).

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: For the writers. The game doesn't show it.

color.title: Colour
color.description: The colour the editor shows it in, like "#ff6fa8".

op.title: Comparison
op.description: How the value is compared. Missing means "==" (">=" in item conditions).

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: "character": each character has their own value (how they see the player), also used between two characters. "global": one value for the whole game.

min.title: Minimum
min.description: Changes never take it below this.

max.title: Maximum
max.description: Changes never take it above this.

start.title: Start
start.description: Where it begins, unless a character's sheet says otherwise.

time.title: Time
time.description: The day count, the parts of the day and the weekdays.

start.title: Start
start.description: When and where the game starts.

day.title: Day
day.description: The day number the game starts on.

hour.title: Hour
hour.description: The hour the game starts at (0-23). Missing: the start of the first phase, or 8.

place.title: Place
place.description: Where the player is when the game starts.

phases.title: Phases
phases.description: The parts of the day. An hour falls in the last phase that started by then; before the first one it is still the last one (night, past midnight).

weekdays.title: Weekdays
weekdays.description: Optional. Day 1 is the first on the list, day 2 the next, and round.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Kinds of thing it is, so a talk can react to a kind (given_tag) instead of a list.

start.title: Start
start.description: How many the player has when the game starts.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: The editor's checks for the game's text box. 0 or missing: no check. The game may ignore them.

character.title: Character
character.description: Someone who talks. "narrator" is not a character but can say lines.

name.title: Name
name.description: What they are called. For the player, what the player is called ("You", "Detective"...).

moods.title: Moods
moods.description: The faces or tones their lines can have.

stats.title: Stats
stats.description: Where each character stat starts for them.

label.title: Label
label.description: Only a note ("her boss", "owes him money").

values.title: Values
values.description: Where the character stats start between the two.

character.title: Character
character.description: Whose talk it is. Conditions and effects that name no one mean this character.

status.title: Status
status.description: The game decides what to do with drafts.

places.title: Places
places.description: Where it can happen. Missing: anywhere.

required.title: Required
required.description: A story talk that must happen (a note for the game: the format doesn't enforce it).

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.description: It can happen again after it has been seen once.

if.title: Conditions
if.description: All must hold for it to start.

start.title: Start
start.description: The id of the first node.

node.title: Node
node.description: A block of lines followed by what happens next.

effects.description: Applied once the lines are said.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What comes after the lines. "line": go on to next. "choice": the player picks one of the options that hold. "give": the player gives (or shows) an item, or nothing, then the first option that holds. "branch": the first option that holds. "random": one at random of the options that hold.

options.title: Options
options.description: In every mode but "line". In give and branch, an option with no conditions holds always: put it last, as the else.

next.title: Next
next.description: In mode "line": a node id, or "end".

text.title: Text
text.description: Can carry {player} (the player's name), {name} (the talk's character) and {item} (the item given, or else the one asked for).

ask.title: Ask
ask.description: In mode "give": what the character asks for. Both fields are optional.

item.title: Item
item.description: The item asked for, for the condition given_asked and {item}.

text.title: Text
text.description: What they ask for, in words ("something sweet").

option.title: Option
option.description: A player's answer (in choice), or a way on (in give, branch, random).

text.title: Text
text.description: What the player says (only in choice).

if.title: Conditions
if.description: All must hold for the option to be offered (or the branch taken).

effects.description: Applied when it is picked, before the reply.

next.title: Next
next.description: A node id, "end", or "back" (only in choice: offer the same options again, without the ones already picked in this talk).

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: Something that holds or not, told apart by its type.

statCondition.description: The stat compares to the value.

who.title: Who
who.description: Whose value. Left out for global stats; for character stats, missing means the talk's character.

relationCondition.description: How from sees to compares to the value.

flagCondition.description: The flag is on (value true) or off (value false).

value.title: Value
value.description: true: on, false: off. Missing means true, so keep false in the file.

itemCondition.description: How many the player has compares to the value.

dayCondition.description: The day number compares to the value.

weekdayCondition.description: Today is one of these weekdays.

phaseCondition.description: The hour falls in one of these phases.

hourCondition.description: from <= hour < to; past midnight when from > to (20 to 2); the whole day when they are equal.

placeCondition.description: The player is in one of these places.

seenCondition.description: That talk has (value true) or hasn't (value false) been seen to its end.

value.title: Value
value.description: true: seen, false: not yet. Missing means true, so keep false in the file.

givenCondition.description: After a give node: the item given is one of these.

givenNotCondition.description: After a give node: something was given, and it's none of these.

givenTagCondition.description: After a give node: the item given has one of these tags.

givenLikedCondition.description: After a give node: the item given is one the talk's character likes.

givenDislikedCondition.description: After a give node: the item given is one the talk's character dislikes.

givenAskedCondition.description: After a give node: the item given is the one asked for (ask.item).

givenNoneCondition.description: After a give node: the player gave nothing.

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: A change to the state (or, for event, something for the game to do), told apart by its type.

statEffect.description: Adds delta to the stat, within its min and max.

who.title: Who
who.description: Whose value. Left out for global stats; for character stats, missing means the talk's character.

relationEffect.description: Adds delta to how from sees to, within the stat's min and max.

flagEffect.description: Turns a flag on or off.

value.title: Value
value.description: true: on, false: off. Missing means true, so keep false in the file.

itemEffect.description: Gives (+) or takes (-) items; never below 0. Giving an item in a give node doesn't take it away by itself.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: "hours"; "phases" (to the start of the next part of the day, each); "days" (same hour).

placeEffect.description: The player is now in that place.

eventEffect.description: Changes nothing in the state: something for the game to do.
